notes.subject: plate
notes.text: Long white front plates and short yellow rear plates.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Generation 3 shows the car front through the blur as blue, white and red patches; unique to this country.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: All Generation 4 coverage is low-cam, with a big blur and wide-looking roads; Generation 3 is normal height.

notes.subject: language
notes.text: Two local scripts: a very curvy rounded one found everywhere, and a straighter-lined one concentrated in the north, east and central hills; the first is unique here.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: Square concrete poles with small pinholes only in the upper part.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: Concrete poles with large see-through holes in the lower half, unique to this country.

notes.subject: bollard
notes.text: Short wide tapered stone bollards with a black base and white top.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Tall white concrete waystones with an indented lower section holding a yellow road number.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Sign posts striped black and white.

notes.subject: line
notes.text: Rural roads often have edge lines but no centre line; many small roads have no lines at all.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Lush green tropical vegetation, dense population and patchwork fields; red soil is common and palms are very common.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Orange or red tiled roofs, often weathered to a brownish tint.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Majority Buddhist: temples, Buddha statues, stupas and Buddhist flags are common.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Bulky tuktuks with black roofs, usually green, yellow or red.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Some coverage uses a low-quality camera with a wide circular blur and brownish colours.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Landlines have a three-digit area code starting with 0; mobile numbers start with 07.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Hindu temples and the straighter-lined script dominate the north, parts of the east and the area around the central hill town.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Islam is strongest on the east coast, though not a majority anywhere.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Christianity is mostly in the northwest, strongest around one northwestern coastal town.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The southwest is wetter with dense deep-green vegetation; the rest is a bit drier with browner tones.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Hills and mountains are concentrated in the central-south.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Compact bright-green tea shrubs in organised rows on hillsides, most common in the central hills.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Hilly plains of long grass with distant forest and wide open roads.
